edges.notes: Data Scientist approves model in SageMaker Model Registry.
Model Registry triggers notification to ML Engineer upon approval.
ML Engineer invokes XAMD deployment API in QA Account.
XAMD interacts with Model Registry to fetch model artifacts.
Model artifact is deployed from Model Registry to QA SageMaker Endpoint.
XAMD QA provisions and updates QA SageMaker Endpoint.
ML Engineer invokes XAMD deployment API in Production Account after QA validation.
Model artifact is promoted from QA Endpoint environment to Production Endpoint.
XAMD PROD provisions and updates Production SageMaker Endpoint.
Production Endpoint serves disease and crop predictions to the Mobile app.
